name: AIWget

sources.title: Submit page — 'Paid submission'; form asks only tool name, website URL, contact email; one-time $19.90 or Unlimited $29.90/mo; Stripe/PayPal

requirements: AI-related tools only — FAQ: 'We do not include websites that are inaccessible, unrelated to AI, duplicate another listing, or fail review'
Payment upfront: $19.90 one-time ($26.90 list) or $29.90/mo Unlimited for multiple tools; card via Stripe or PayPal
Website must be accessible for review
Only three fields needed: tool name, website URL, contact email — AIWget writes the listing copy itself
preparation: Confirm the product is genuinely an AI tool
Tool name, canonical website URL, contact email
A good public landing page — AIWget 'prepares a clear, search-friendly tool page using information available on your website', so your own copy is the listing source
workflow: Enter tool name, website URL, contact email
Choose one-time ($19.90) or Unlimited ($29.90/mo) submit type
One-time submissions reviewed within 48h; Unlimited members get a 24h window; refund issued if a paid one-time submission is not approved
watchFor: No free tier at all — the page is labeled 'Paid submission'
Dofollow link is a selling point, which makes this primarily a paid-link play; weigh SEO value of a paid dofollow directory link
Homepage placement is NOT permanent even though the listing page is — 'homepage placement changes as new tools are added'
Unlimited plan renews monthly until canceled — set a reminder to cancel
Published listings are non-refundable for traffic/performance; only rejected submissions get refunded
Login exists but the submit flow is pay-then-submit, so no account is strictly needed for a one-time listing
countsAsLive: A tool page is published on aiwget.com (browseable under /explore or a category page) with a link to your site
unknowns: Whether the $19.90 vs $26.90 'list' pricing is permanent or a promo display
Review rejection rate — rejection reasons listed are access, AI-relevance, duplicates
